blocking.message: Current candidate fails source quality; exact inverse replay of the same encoded latent cannot repair its VAE-only endpoint.
Equal source/control MSE weights resist source restoration toward a poor reference; revised scientific objective requires explicit versioning.
No quality-constrained saved-PNG latent-to-blind-DCT score separation or calibrated detection evidence exists.
Radius-one public-code recovery and dimension-bound DCT templates have no robustness or synchronization evidence.
Full numerical method acceptance, native2K coverage, fair speed comparison and study-level quality rule remain unestablished.

non_blocking.message: Guided solver is modified GNRI-inspired code; prior objective and dimension/timestep scaling do not guarantee residual convergence.
Frozen-decoder refinement is justified but untested; its penalty, strict projection and MSE-only endpoint limit interpretations.
Published better-quality systems contradict blanket impossibility but differ in architecture, detector and evaluation protocol.

Generic evidence helper not applied: authoritative claim inventory is CSV and outcome analyses are descriptive retained JSON, not the helper's strict JSONL/generic-analysis contract; no synthetic evidence adapters were fabricated.

coverage_note: All five reports inspected; only saved-pair/localization outcome JSON and source-literature hashes independently rechecked here. No claim of complete run-manifest/input hash verification or metric reproduction. See checklist.
